source: ComicsBox USA series indexes, ComicsBox issue character credits, and existing MarvelTracker paths
rules: Dedicated and co-billed series are followed issue by issue using their first verified Italian publication.
Configured issue selectors are used for anthology or mantle-sharing series; unselected issues are excluded.
Shared history is reused only when the character is credited among the protagonists of a USA story already represented by an existing MarvelTracker path.
Simple appearances/cameos are excluded from shared-history reuse.
A physical Italian issue keeps its existing global ownership ID; reading progress remains path-local through readingStep.contentIds.
Missing or invalid source series are audited and never replaced with invented Italian editions.
Punisher MAX, Noir and other non-616 continuities are excluded from the Frank Castle Terra-616 path.

paths.name: Occhio di Falco
paths.subtitle: Clint Barton · Hawkeye
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Clint Barton dalle prime serie soliste alle fasi West Coast Avengers, Ronin e Hawkeye moderne, con riuso protagonista-only delle storie condivise.

paths.name: Vedova Nera
paths.subtitle: Natasha Romanoff · Black Widow
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Natasha Romanoff tra spionaggio, Vendicatori, missioni soliste e storie condivise in cui è protagonista.

paths.name: Luke Cage
paths.subtitle: Carl Lucas · Power Man
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Luke Cage da Hero for Hire e Power Man fino agli Heroes for Hire e ai Nuovi Vendicatori.

paths.name: Iron Fist
paths.subtitle: Danny Rand · Pugno d'Acciaio
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Danny Rand dalle origini su Marvel Premiere alle serie Iron Fist, Power Man and Iron Fist e Immortal Iron Fist.

paths.name: Jessica Jones
paths.subtitle: Jessica Jones · Alias
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Jessica Jones da Alias e The Pulse alle serie moderne, con le storie condivise selezionate solo quando Jessica è protagonista.

paths.name: Punisher
paths.subtitle: Frank Castle · Il Punitore
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Frank Castle dalle serie classiche alle incarnazioni Marvel Knights e moderne; le linee MAX e le realtà alternative sono escluse.

paths.name: Moon Knight
paths.subtitle: Marc Spector · Cavaliere della Luna
paths.description: Percorso Terra-616 di Marc Spector dalle origini in Werewolf by Night alle serie classiche, Mr. Knight e alle incarnazioni contemporanee, collegato sia allo street level sia al soprannaturale.
